pages.title: Bean Quality
pages.text: Every bean has a $(thing)quality$(): $(#b3322c)Poor$(), Decent, $(#3b8a2e)Good$() or $(#b8860b)Great$(). It shows in the bean's tooltip.$(br2)A bush's beans get their quality from the $(thing)biome$() the bush grows in, not from the bean it grew from. So where you plant matters!

pages.title: Best Biomes
pages.text: $(li)$(#b8860b)Great$(): jungles$(li)$(#3b8a2e)Good$(): savannas$(li)Decent: everywhere else, like plains and forests$(li)$(#b3322c)Poor$(): cold places, like taigas and snowy biomes$(br2)Quality is kept through roasting, grinding and brewing, and better coffee lasts longer when you drink it.
